tg_glassmaster: The city is named for us, whatever the harbour board tell you.
Sand off the bar, ash off the kelp, and a furnace lit since my grandmother.
Everything here is made of the coast. That is the only trick there is.
tg_glass_prentice: I get the blue-green wrong every time. Master says it is not a colour, it is a depth.
She says the old people down the coast could do it and we cannot.
Then she goes quiet and puts more ash in, which is what she does instead of answering.
